name: @sos-2/tests-real-persistence
description: SOS 2.0 Real Persistence + Deployment Connectivity Suites (Work Order P17-A): TWO strictly separated suites. (1) The DETERMINISTIC reference-mode suite — offline (a scripted FetchPort for every provider seam — no network, fixed vitest seed 424242, run-to-run identical): the frozen P2 port contract compliance of the REAL adapters over scripted providers (durable row model with upsert/if_absent/compare-and-set, deterministic listRows, coordination cache/idempotency/leases with TTL discipline, the flushAll never-canonical proof, write-once content-addressed objects with idempotent re-puts and byte-exact read-back), the honest-state machine (UNKNOWN before any probe; CONNECTED after a 2xx probe; UNAVAILABLE on DNS/network/auth failures with the real reason recorded; DEGRADED on 429 — never fabricated), the frozen-port health bridge (AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/UNKNOWN), the structural alignment of the P3 infra vocabulary mirror with the REAL frozen infra/deployment sources (non-literal dynamic imports — the P17-B pinning precedent), the P3 SigV4 signing shape, the redaction discipline (credential VALUES never in transcripts, provider-state reports, outcomes or evidence), the Vercel provider request/response mapping + deployment record minting (exact source_revision_sha, revision registrar records with rollback pointers, truthful outcome aggregation through the frozen @sos-2/deployment store), and the composition wiring (env-only resolution; unconfigured providers honestly UNKNOWN). (2) The env-gated REAL-provider integration suite (RUN_REAL=1, default OFF, separate vitest config): the real journeys — Neon provisioning + real SQL roundtrip (or the honest UNAVAILABLE transcript), the Upstash coordination roundtrip + the flush-loses-nothing canonical proof against the REAL durable store (or the honest UNAVAILABLE transcript), the R2 write-once object journey (bucket provisioning + 1-byte and multi-byte objects + byte-exact read-back + the retention-path delete), and the REAL Vercel deployment of apps/web bound to the exact branch head — each recording machine-readable JSON evidence (request/response summaries, ids, revisions, timestamps, durations) into docs/evidence/production-connectivity/persistence-deployment. A provider outage during the run is recorded as UNAVAILABLE evidence, never a silent skip.
